subject: ProdGen demo follow-up & proposed trial framework
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@praxisretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: ProdGen demo follow-up & proposed trial framework

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a proposed way to run a short POC so you can validate latency/cost and the extraction accuracy on your receipts pipeline. Keeping this tight to 3 weeks so we can get you live with measurable results.

What we demoed (recap):
- ProdGen model for structured extraction (line items, totals, merchant)
- Streaming inference + prefix caching for repeated vendor templates
- Console: token breakdown, latency percentiles, per-route dashboards

Proposed trial (3-week) — high level:
1) Week 0 (prep, 3–5 days): Secure test dataset (anonymized), define 10 core templates, set success criteria + sample prompts.
2) Week 1 (baseline eval): Run baseline against current in-house extraction on 1k receipts, capture accuracy (F1) and p95 latency.
3) Week 2 (optimization): Try quantized model + caching, iterate prompts, tune batching.
4) Week 3 (finalize & handoff): Produce report, recommended config for production, suggested SLOs and cost estimates.

Success criteria (suggested):
- Line-item extraction F1 >= 0.92 on validation set
- Merchant and total amount exact-match >= 0.98
- p95 latency <= 250ms for single-request path with prefetched cache
- End-to-end token cost < $0.015 per doc for 95th percentile workload

Ownership & contacts:
- Redwood POC owner: Marissa Cole (cc'd on follow-ups) — trial coordination, test environment, and evaluation report
- Technical contact (Praxis): Jordan Park — dataset access and labeling questions

Next steps / ask of you this week:
- Share anonymized sample set (1k receipts) or give read-only S3 link by Tue 20 Jan
- Confirm baseline metrics you currently report (accuracy, latency)
- Approve trial timeline and kickoff 30-min call (I proposed Wed 21 Jan below)

Attachments: RDW_Trial_Outline_Praxis_v1.pdf (trial plan), MVP_prompt_set.csv (seed prompts)

Thanks — I’ll schedule the kickoff once we get the data link.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

3) Can you confirm the SLA / p95 target for Hosted API during the trial and whether burst capacity is covered?

Also — can you share an initial estimate of expected monthly cost at the volume band we discussed (~200k docs/month) so our finance lead knows whether to greenlight the trial?

On timing: Wed 21 Jan is tight for our internal reviewers; would Thu 22 Jan 10:00am PT work? If not, Friday morning is our fallback.

Best,
Samantha Lee

Samantha — great questions. Short answers and follow-ups below.

1) Security pack: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 summary + our data handling SOP. For the trial we normally require masked/anonymized PDFs or extracted text only; if you prefer client-side OCR we can accept a compressed extracted-text payload instead of raw PDFs. I’ll attach the one-page data policy.

2) Endpoints: we’ll give you two endpoints for the trial — /v1/prodgen/extract (fast path, streaming supported) and /v1/prodgen/extract-batch (for bulk runs). Both routes are available on Hosted with trial tier that includes burst capacity up to 2x baseline. p95 target we aim for is 250ms; we’ll instrument and report actual p50/p95.

3) Cost estimate: based on conversation and early telemetry, estimated token-cost range is $0.009–$0.014 per doc at 200k/month assuming caching of templates; full price estimate and commitment tiers are in the attached outline. For trial purposes we can grant a $5k credit to cover experimentation.

Kickoff: Thu 22 Jan 10:00am PT confirmed for the 30-minute kickoff. I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and agenda.

Marissa will be the POC owner and will coordinate the environment. Marissa — can you provision a trial API key (scoped, time-limited) and a GitHub repo for prompt iterations once we have the S3 link?

Attachments: ProdGen_DataPolicy_1pager.pdf (data handling summary)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Irene
